name: Grandmother Skein
place: wilds: the zone event boss. Rises from the old sinkhole in Mawehaven's barley field (~832, 576); needs ~40 m of open, walkable ground. Rotates with the zone's other events; every player nearby is enrolled.
_doc: Stream E. The ZONE EVENT BOSS for Torborhold's zone (many players). A spider older than the village, who speaks like everyone's grandmother. P1 'Hush, Now': a spinneret lash for the front, webs flung at random players, and a LULLABY that puts the whole field to sleep unless someone interrupts it — or you stand behind a hay rick (line of sight). P2 at 60% 'The Brood': she climbs into the old barn behind a silk ward; her three egg sacs hatch spiders until you BURN them (use them like a brazier). Burning all three drops the ward. P3 is a new health bar 'Grandmother's Embrace': cocoon stacks, threads in six directions, a get-under-her ring, and the well's clean water heals anyone standing at it. Soft enrage from 4 minutes, hard at 7.
party: Zone event, everyone nearby joins. Solo: not intended (cocoon stack needs 3, three egg sacs to burn under adds). 3-5: playable. 10+: intended. M5 scaling: health and spider adds by players enrolled; cocoon need = clamp(players/4, 2, 5); egg sacs 3 -> 5 at 15+.

pull: Hush now, little ones. Grandmother is awake.
Oh, visitors! And nobody told me. Come closer, dears, my eyes aren't what they were.
So many of you. Grandmother will need a bigger pantry.
say.death: Grandmother Skein curls up like a dead leaf. 'Such... rude... children...'
say.reset: Grandmother Skein sinks back into the earth, humming.

soft.say: The web over the field thickens.

web_volley.name: Web Volley
web_volley.say: Grandmother flings silk across the field!

lullaby.name: Grandmother's Lullaby
say: Shh, shh. Go to sleep, my little ones...
Grandmother starts to sing — interrupt her, or get behind a hay rick!

brood_call.name: Brood Call
brood_call.say: The egg sacs split. Grandmother's babies are hungry!

cocoon.name: Silk Cocoon
cocoon.say: Grandmother is wrapping {target} for later — stand with them, three of you!

threads.name: Thread the Needle
threads.say: Six threads snap taut across the field!

embrace.name: Grandmother's Embrace
embrace.say: Her legs spread wide — come give Grandmother a hug! (Get under her!)

phases.name: The Brood
phases.say: You've upset the babies. Grandmother needs a little lie-down.

onEnter.say: A ward of silk closes over Grandmother Skein. Burn all three egg sacs!

phases.name: Grandmother's Embrace
phases.say: My babies! My BABIES! Oh, you will pay for that, dears.

do.say: The last egg sac shrivels in the flames. Grandmother shrieks and drops from the barn!
Every hay rick is torn apart — nothing left to hide behind!
